items.title: Why Micron Stock Is Jumping as Intel CEO Warns on Memory Chips
items.summary: Micron Technology  stock was back on the rise early Thursday.  A warning from the head of  Intel  about soaring memory prices looks to be reminding shareholders of the company’s profit potential.  Micron shares were up 5.4% at $976.51 in early trading.
